summary: Russia conducted large-scale overnight attacks using 68 rockets and 351 drones, with 29 ballistic missiles hitting 34 locations across Ukraine. Ukrainian air defenses shot down 363 targets but failed to intercept any ballistic missiles. Civilian casualties mounted with 10 killed and 46 injured in Kyiv alone.

Air defense shot down 363 targets but failed to intercept any ballistic missiles (Source: @eRadarrua/99922).
Kyiv attack killed 10 and injured 46 including 5 children (Source: @UkraineNow/82436).
Ukraine attacked Omsk NPP - Russia's last unoccupied refinery 2500km from border (Source: @eRadarrua/99940).
Fighting continues in Kostiantynivka with Russians consolidating around Illynivka and Novodmitrivka (Source: @DeepStateUA/23621).

sections.executive_summary: Russia conducted large-scale overnight attacks using 68 rockets and 351 drones, with 29 ballistic missiles hitting 34 locations across Ukraine. Ukrainian air defenses shot down 363 targets but failed to intercept any ballistic missiles. Civilian casualties mounted with 10 killed and 46 injured in Kyiv alone.

points: Air defense officials acknowledged shortage of interceptor missiles needed to shoot down ballistic missiles, with Defense Minister Fedorov announcing Patriot missile deliveries will not begin until next year (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31407, @ukr_leaks_eng/31409).
Kyiv attack resulted in 10 killed and 46 injured including 5 children, with destruction across multiple locations (Source: @UkraineNow/82436).
Vishnevy attack destroyed nearly 5 streets, evacuated 500 people due to explosion risk, caused 3 deaths including 9-month-old and 12-year-old, with 26 injured (Source: @UkraineNow/82444).
Zaporizhzhia attack killed policeman and injured 8 others including 15-year-old, with private residential sector also hit (Source: @UkraineNow/82433).
Nova Poshta logistics centers hit in Kyiv's Obolonsky district and Zaporizhzhia (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31419).
Channel 5 television office in Kyiv damaged in airstrike on Rybalsky Island (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31406).
Power outages affected 6 regions and 58 settlements in Sumy region due to weather and attacks (Source: @UkraineNow/82440).
Conducted overnight attack using 68 rockets and 351 drones, with 29 ballistic missiles hitting 34 locations (Source: @UkraineNow/82438).
Attacked Omsk NPP - Russia's last unoccupied refinery located approximately 2500km from Ukrainian border (Source: @eRadarrua/99940).
Demanded Sweden respect Vienna Convention after drone attack on Russian embassy in Stockholm (Source: @tass_agency/384007).
Claimed Ukrainian drone attack on Sevastopol museum was a British-planned provocation (Source: @tass_agency/383981).
Ambassador left Russian embassy in Sweden after drone attack (Source: @tass_agency/384006).
Attacked fuel tankers in Azov Sea carrying 7000 tons each of fuel to Crimea (Source: @UkraineNow/82448).
S-400 air defense systems hit by drones in Crimea and Bryansk region (Source: @UkraineNow/82448).
Active fighting in Kostiantynivka with Russians consolidating around Illynivka and Novodmitrivka to cut off city movement (Source: @DeepStateUA/23621).

sections.threat_assessment: Russian forces conducted large-scale overnight attacks using 68 rockets and 351 drones, demonstrating sustained aerial warfare capability. Despite Ukrainian air defenses shooting down 363 targets, no ballistic missiles were intercepted, highlighting critical capability gaps. The attack resulted in significant civilian casualties including 10 killed and 46 injured in Kyiv, with similar impacts across multiple regions.
sections.regional_response: Ukrainian forces demonstrated extended reach by attacking Omsk NPP - Russia's last unoccupied refinery - indicating expanded operational capabilities. Air defense officials acknowledged interceptor missile shortages and requested additional Patriot missile supplies at NATO summit. Civilian infrastructure came under repeated attack with residential areas and logistics centers targeted.
sections.intelligence_notes: Russian drone operations showed coordinated movement patterns across multiple regions with specific directional vectors reported. The use of 68 rockets and 351 drones represents a significant escalation in aerial attack volume. Air defense failures against ballistic missiles suggest either technical limitations or insufficient interceptor supplies.
